headline: INFINITE's Kim Myung Soo leads Wavve rom-com in January
sub: He and Pyo Ye Jin co-sign a newlywed loan in 'Joint Guarantee Romance'

info.title: At a glance
rows: Kim Myung Soo, Pyo Ye Jin

caption:
INFINITE's Kim Myung Soo (L) returns to the screen in Wavve original 'Joint Guarantee Romance' (연대보증 로맨스), premiering January 2027.

He plays Lee Jung-sik, a woodworker who dreams of becoming a wood designer, opposite Pyo Ye Jin as home-shopping MD Na Da-un. The two become each other's joint guarantors to get a newlywed loan, a purely practical deal that slowly turns into romance. The series is directed by Kang Min-gu ('Itaewon Class').

📌 Source: Wavve, via Korean media
